column1: # Rank stats for a new level 1. Written first so a drop during the later wipe keeps level 1. Minimum and maximum XP stay in script because they come from the rank table.
# Default weapons left unlocked: M9 USP MP5 M16 M40A3 W1200 SAW and frag grenade.
# Starter perks stay unlocked. 1 is the unlocked value.
# Custom classes. Each block is flag / primary / primary attachment / secondary / secondary attachment / perk 1 / perk 2 / perk 3 / special grenade / camo.
# Class 1 assault. Flag 200 stays 1. M16 with grenade launcher. M9. Stopping Power. Extreme Conditioning. Stun.
# Class 2 spec ops. Flag 210 stays 0 until Create-a-Class unlocks. MP5. Silenced USP. C4. Sonic Boom. Steady Aim. Flash.
# Class 3 heavy gunner. Flag 220 stays 0. SAW. USP. Three special grenades. Juggernaut. Deep Impact. Stun.
# Class 4 demolitions. Flag 230 stays 0. W1200. M9. RPG. Sonic Boom. Extreme Conditioning. Smoke.
# Class 5 sniper. Flag 240 stays 0. M40A3. Silenced M9. Three special grenades. Stopping Power. Deep Impact. Flash.
# Menu rank stats 251-258. Create-a-Class (260) and Challenges (263). 0 locks both features until they are earned again.
# Challenge group buttons 270-279. 0 locks all ten groups. Rank-up opens them again when the challenge state below is 0.
# Perk and item bytes under 200 set to locked. The starter perks above are left out of these ranges.
# Other class blocks outside custom classes 200-249. Cleared so an old loadout is not kept.
# Challenge state 501-698. Must be 0 or the rank unlock skips the group and the button stays locked.
# Challenge progress 2501-2698. Old counts are cleared so a challenge cannot finish on the first action after it unlocks.
# Weapon unlock stats except the default weapons above.
# Power-rank attachment and camo list counts. Cleared so the next unlock pass starts from the beginning.
